en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a vaulted stone passageway with heavy masonry arches, likely part of an old cloister or church ruin. In the background are Gothic-style window openings without glass, and in the foreground a later-added electric lamp hangs from the stone arch. The scene has a narrow corridor feel, with rough stone walls and worn floor. Along the lower border of the postcard there is cursive text.
